svg.title: GitHub activity: 4,696 publicly displayed contributions
svg.desc: A three-dimensional GitHub activity calendar showing 4,696 publicly displayed contributions in the last six months, from 2026-05-08 through 2026-11-08. Bars use the pinned upstream github-profile-3d-contrib geometry and log-scaled daily counts; face color follows GitHub's contribution level. The presentation fits the selected weeks into the viewport. GitHub's public display may include privacy-obscured activity. No private repositories were accessed.
svg.text: Bar height: upstream log scale · color: GitHub level
